senses.sense_definition: A shout, whistle, or sexually suggestive comment made toward a person passing by.

examples.text: She ignored the vulgar <w>catcall</w> coming from the construction site across the street.
Many women feel unsafe walking alone at night because of frequent street <w>catcalls</w>.

senses.sense_definition: A harsh shout, whistle, or jeer expressing strong disapproval, especially from an audience.

examples.text: The politician's speech was interrupted by loud jeers and <w>catcalls</w> from the audience.
His poor performance was met with a chorus of boos and angry <w>catcalls</w>.

senses.sense_definition: A small whistle or squeaking instrument formerly used by theatergoers to express disapproval.

examples.text: Historical theatergoers would blow through a small <w>catcall</w> to show their displeasure with the play.
He produced an antique <w>catcall</w> and explained how audiences once used it to disrupt performances.

traits.comment: Refers to a historical practice and instrument

senses.sense_definition: A run-time error in the Eiffel programming language caused by using the wrong data type.

examples.text: The developer struggled to resolve the <w>catcall</w> error reported during the runtime check.
Adopting strict export policies helps prevent runtime <w>catcalls</w> in your Eiffel system.

senses.sense_definition: To shout, whistle, or make derogatory or sexually suggestive remarks, or to jeer at someone.

examples.text: Several men started to <w>catcall</w> as she walked down the busy avenue.
The hostile crowd began to <w>catcall</w> the referee after the controversial decision.
